text: The Soul of Des'Altek drops from Des'Altek in . It can be combined with the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Devouring) in order to create the Scythe of Chaos.

The Soul of Devouring is obtained by using Drain Soul on a Ravenous Felhound. It can be combined with the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Enthralling) in order to create the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Devouring).

The Soul of Enthralling is obtained by using Drain Soul on the Fel Interloper summoned from the Large Fel Rift in the Plaguewood. It can be combined with the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Void) in order to create the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Enthralling).
The Soul of Mischief is obtained by using Drain Soul on Xirath. It can be combined with the Depleted Scythe of Chaos in order to create the Depleted Scythe of Chaos (Mischief).
Soul Infusers are venthyr that spawn during the Sun King's Salvation fight in Pride's Prison in Castle Nathria.

Soul Reaper's Raiment is the Battle of Dazar'alor set for cloth-wearers. Several items from both the Battle of Dazar'alor and the Crucible of Storms can count towards collecting the appearance. A few pieces that can be crafted with Battle for Azeroth Tailoring can unlock the normal difficulty appearance. Completing the set grants the Daz'aling Attire achievement.
Soul Miser is an Affliction warlock talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Cascading Calamity (warlock talent).
Soul Cleanse is a demon hunter class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Burn It Out.

Soul of the Void is obtained from using Drain Soul on a Syndicate Conjuror's voidwalker in Stromgarde Keep in the . Combining it with 10 Conjuror's Pendant near a void prism in one of the houses will summon the Void Seeker.
